## Registry Definition

A medical registry consolidates related records from multiple sources (intrastate, interstate, or federal agencies) into one comprehensive data store. This data store may or may not reside within the Medicaid information system.

## Registry Types

| Registry | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| Immunizations | Vaccine tracking |
| Cancer | Cancer diagnosis/treatment |
| Disease | General disease tracking |
| Heart | Cardiovascular conditions |
| Diabetes | Diabetes management |

## Constraints & Failures

- **Constraints**: State and federal regulations regarding entities authorized to access registry information
- **Potential Failures**:
    - Unable to find registry information to update
    - Requestor does not have authorized access to Registry
